correctness.rationale: In a reduced rooted tree of at most three tips, the only nonadditive descendant clade has two tips. The gain therefore has the exact form A1_a+B1_b+C1_c-T1_bc with T>=0. All greedy first/second choice cases rigorously dominate the other pairs, including ties. The four-tip comb has all positive edge lengths, a common untreated survival probability 1/2, positive imperfect improved survivals, and exact rational gains verified independently via edge products and full 16-survivor-state enumeration for every intervention subset; the unique greedy pair loses by 11/50.

originality.rationale: The primary 2006 paper establishes general four-taxon greedy failure and common-multiplier sufficiency, but its displayed failure has unequal pre-intervention survival probabilities (0.6, 0.5, 0.25, 0.25). It does not logically imply a failure under a common pre-intervention probability, nor the complete three-taxon impossibility for all heterogeneous interventions. The exact restricted claim differs in hypotheses and proof; historical priority risk remains due to incomplete access to other plausible papers.
residual_risks: The 2006 Hartmann–Steel paper already displays a four-taxon failure in the unrestricted model; only the equal-baseline restriction plus universally sharp smaller-tree obstruction is distinguished.
An exact equal-baseline four-taxon example could appear in prior unindexed literature, a supplementary table or source not inspected in full.
The Moulton–Semple–Steel (2007) text and Bennett et al. (2014) text were inaccessible; no claim of whole-document noncoverage is made.

value.rationale: Baseline extinction-risk homogeneity is a mathematically and ecologically natural control when assessing whether differences in rescue effectiveness alone invalidate sequential phylogenetic conservation prioritization. The result gives an exact four-taxon lower cutoff and a strict, interpretable intervention choice reversal; the general four-taxon failure and common-multiplier greedy theorem were already known and are not claimed as new. It is not an arbitrary slice of numerical parameter space: the homogeneous-risk restriction isolates an intervention mechanism and the three-taxon proof covers all parameters.
